reviews.text:
My Cat Buttercup needed her nails clip.
Fast ,  quick, safe, caring.
My experience was great I loved the price and they treated my baby Riley with care very nice people would highly recommend
Zero stars, not one but zero. They have physically harmed multiple pets in Delco and Philadelphia. Do NOT trust them with your babies.
Philthy Paws did a great job trimming our anxious rescue dogs nails! They were so good with him and I’m not able to touch his feet at all at home. Thank you!
Lucy is always super happy when she gets her hair cut here.  Lovely local place

I used to go to a "big box pet store" for my 1yr old Siberians grooming needs, then, decided to give give small business a chance, bc,why not?!

Well,this is now my permanent groming place☺️

The owners and entire staff are kind as well as professional. I booked an appt to even out my pets growning out lion cut for the fall/winter ahead.

10 out of 10 service ,communication, and quality of work!

I also recommended  to my sis for her 3 dogs. Please do not hesitate to book here, you will NOT regret it!

Their work was leaps and bounds better than the groomings she had at "the big box pet store",no detail was overlooked. And my kitty was chill when I went to pick her up💁🏽‍♀️🥰👍🏽✌🏽🩵

Thank you, PHilthy Paws!!!
I have a very nervous 5lb chihuahua, and PHilthy Paws is the only place I could bring him to get his nails trimmed. They handled him so well and were always so professional and kind.

So very glad PHilthy Paws is in the neighborhood! The incredible team here took amazing care of my very old dog who had many special needs. They even remembered him by name when I called more than a year later to ask about getting my new puppy acclimated to grooming. They've worked closely with us to help my puppy be a good boy at the groomer, and he always comes away looking super sharp!

Took my senior long-haired cat here and he was treated so kindly. He also looks and smells the best he maybe ever has in his entire life. The staff is super friendly, and the vibes overall are great. We’ll definitely be back :)
lovely shop. always in and out so fast, we go here to get my cats claws trimmed once a month because she won’t let us do it at home. staff is so sweet and always gives her treats afterward.

The staff here take such good care of my elderly pup. Every time I bring her, she gets so excited to be there and never wants to leave. The staff make her smell and look amazing and are able to file her nails even though she doesn’t let me do it. They always give her a treat and send her home in a bandana or bow tie. Excellent job!

If I could give this place 0 stars I would!!!!!! My mother was doing me a favor by getting my cat groomed while I went out of state. I told her to go to Pet Smart but she just insisted on going to “Philthy Paws” because it “looked nice”🙄. The contract that they had my mother sign was ridiculous! The contract stated that if they accidentally hurt your pet while grooming them, then it’s not their fault and any emergency services rendered (the bill) will go to you and you have to pay it ….so let me get this straight. If under their care they happen to bruise my cat then I have to be OK with it. Not cool!! She also told my mother apart of grooming was deshedding him, bathing , cutting the hair out his ears.  My mom goes back to pick up the cat and 1. She claimed before bathing him , he wouldn’t let go of whatever was in the back that he was holding on too and he hurt his foot. So keep a eye on it later 2.She never cut the hair out his ears , my mom asked her why and she said “because she didn’t ask “, my mom said but that was apart of the services included in the bill I paid for and showed the woman the contract that she gave her and the woman still insisted next time my mom needs to let them know 3. She deshedded him “a little bit” and told my mom to bring him back next week so she can make sure all the hair is gone ….I come in from out of state today just to see my cat looking the SAME EXACT WAY WHEN I LEFT HIM!!! This lady charged ALOT of money for services that were half down and too bring my cat back next week to make sure all the hair is gone is absorbed !! This was a total waste of money. DO NOT GO HERE!!!!!!! Whenever I got my cat groomed , YOU CAN TELL. He smells good. He looks good and we NEVER have to bring him back to make sure all the hair is gone! A total waste of money!!! He is still the hairy fur ball with all kind of hair sticking out his head and ears when I left him. 👎🏾👎🏾👎🏾

This was my very first time doing a self groom for my golden doodle. The staff at philthy paws was excellent! They offered help, gave clear instructions for the equipment & were very welcoming, they also cleaned my dogs ears & clipped his nails. I will definitely be back!
Our first time here was wonderful I didn't need to bring a thing! The environment was calm, inviting and the price was just right.

Staff was great with my little lady! Guy named Darnell took the time to answer all my questions. My pup is horrible when getting nails trimmed but they handled her easily. They were very knowledgeable and helpful. Would go back 😊 …
